description: REPLICA of Manfred von Richthofen's triplane erected in his birth city on ul. Sikorskiego. The OSM name reads "Fokker Dr. 3" which is a mapper error for Dr.I; documented by polska-org.pl object 9083172 and fotopolska.eu object 408987
aliases: DrI; Dr.1; Dr1; Fokker Dr.I; Dreidecker; Fokker Dr. 3
